rubrics.justification: The response largely restates the provided Gardner 3AA label rather than analyzing visible image features, and it incorrectly calls 3AA a top-tier/highest-quality embryo when 4AA-6AA are generally superior expansion stages.
It thoroughly integrates maternal age, PCOS, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, first-cycle status, paternal age, and semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.
The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis, though some quantitative adjustments are somewhat speculative.

Most recommendations are broadly evidence-based, but strong endorsement of PGT-A for paternal age alone and ERA after a single failed transfer are not well supported by major guidelines; calling 3AA highest category is also imprecise.
Provides clear practical steps for current transfer and future planning, including lifestyle changes and follow-up, though a few suggestions are more optional than guideline-driven.
